reviews.reason: The selected Geʽez matches the supplied printed p. 66/PDF104 scan: the asterisk immediately before the second አንከርኩ is retained, raised apparatus references 18–19 are excluded, all three expressions of wonder remain, ቈላ is singular, and the unit ends with ። before XXVII. The English preserves the repetition and final intensification. The valley/ravine lexical-alternative note is appropriate and makes no modern location claim. Acceptance applies only to 26:6; clipped 26:4, absent 26:5, and other source holds prevent chapter completion.
